# SP1a verdict: the Craft command-line programs in the container (WP-07)

*Generated by `spikes/sp1_craft_cli/drivers/verdict.py` from the evidence files in `build/evidence/wp07/` on 2026-10-19. Nothing here is written by hand; a row says NOT RUN until a real run has produced an envelope. Stand-in CLIs used to test the harness are ignored.*

**A Linux CLI result proves nothing about Windows.** The maker's Sat 24 Oct five-minute tests (`MAKER-CRAFT-ZIPS.md`) are the Windows evidence. Everything below is about whether agents can use the CLIs in the cloud container, CPU only, no GPU.

## 2. The decision (R8 rule)

R8 decision rule (research/craft-motion.md): if T2 and T4 pass, agents may render drafts and chapters with the Craft CLIs in the container (still producing OTIO and ffmpeg fallbacks); if T2 fails, FilmCraft stays maker-side and the container renders with ffmpeg and code; if T4 fails on memory or speed, EffectCraft is limited to titles and line-draw on the maker's PC.

**Outcome: UNDECIDED. T2 and T4 have not been run.** Until they are, the plan's default stands: the container renders with ffmpeg, Pillow and Chromium (Route A), and FilmCraft and EffectCraft are maker-side refinement tools. ROADMAP 5.2 says "Craft CLIs: only if SP1 T2/T4 pass", so nothing is planned on them.
